title: Project Launch
body: With our 7,777 unique burgers in our first drop, your taste buds are about to go nuts. Each burger is a complex combo of all kinds of interdimensional flavors. We’ll bring crazy side dishes to the table in our second drop, and even more later down the road. Check out the project timeline for more details.
conclusion: Get ready; our chefs par excellence are putting wheels on it!

title: Giveaways
body: Did someone say free burgers?! We’ll be hosting numerous giveaways giving our Discord community members multiple chances to win one out of 40 of our Burger NFTs, cash prizes, and more in the total value of 100 000$.
conclusion: Don’t miss out! Join our Discord to learn more.

title: Rewards
body: Hold tight; there’s more! As a reward and in exchange for the trust and commitment, our Burger holders will be gifted free second drop Side Dish NFT and token later on down the project timeline. There will be more benefits for holders, including exclusive Discord channels, using our own token for special offers and opportunities in the Metaverse, and more.

title: Save Lives
body: While we’re a team of true gourmands, we’re also very aware of the alarming growing world hunger rates. The devastating effects of COVID-19, extreme weather and conflict are pushing millions of children and families to the brink right at this moment. Upon sell-out, we’ll donate 10% of out profit to the hunger based charity of choice.
conclusion: Join the fight against hunger, help us on our mission to raise awareness and save lives.

title: Burgerverse
body: The food industry is the largest sector of the global economy, and we’re bringing it to the Metaverse! When all the steps are completed, we plan on becoming the first Metaverse diner franchise with our own token, exclusive events, and special offers for all of our burger-loving holders. Be a part of the first diner franchise in the Metaverse and a number one virtual community for all things tasty.
conclusion: Are you hungry already? Join the feast!
